fusions.name: Heave
fusions.desc: A shove of force that deals 18 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles and knocks it back 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Crushing Weight
fusions.desc: Drops a crushing weight that deals 40 damage, ignoring the target's resistances.

fusions.name: Surge of Force
fusions.desc: Increases your damage by 35% for 12 seconds. For 8 seconds, an escort strikes beside you for 4 every 1.5 seconds.

fusions.name: Unyielding Jaws
fusions.desc: Your physical attacks ignore 20% of the target's armour. Every ability you have comes round 5% sooner.
